Hi - working on LEDGERLIB-113 (vat_summary). The acceptance tests have a contradiction: test_rounding and test_regression_issue_377 both test vat_summary with inputs that produce fractional VAT amounts, but expect different rounding behavior. Hi @eng-85, I checked `src/ledgerlib/round_div.py`. The docstring for 'half_up' specifies that it rounds to the nearest integer and exact halves are rounded up (towards positive infinity). This is implemented using `divmod`, so for negative numbers, a half-way case like -3.5 would round to -3. Hope this helps!
